discussion_comments.comment_body:
I think there are 2 options here:
1. Do nothing and go with what we have here
2. Extend ATC Router

Regarding option 1:
Even if `tb_nkeys` is an `O(n)` operation it does not increase the overall time complexity of this function as it's generally `O(n)`. The next question is how many other `O(n)` operations come here into play so that we could estimate the impact of adding this one. From what I see there are at least 2 other `O(n)` calls: 
- here: https://github.com/Kong/atc-router/blob/main/lib/resty/router/context.lua#L118
- and here: https://github.com/Kong/atc-router/blob/main/src/ffi.rs#L246

So adding a third one will decrease the performance here by ~33% with regard to captures length. Now I reckon - realistically the captures length _shouldn't_ be that long. The URLs are usually at most around 2k characters - maybe up to 8k so in the worst case scenario we have 8k captures.
Now having said all that - I think it might not be an issue but on the other hand it's a hot path and every bit matters so I think we'd need to perf test it.

Regarding option 2:
The captures length is _right there_. If it's helpful we can just return it with captures table: https://github.com/Kong/atc-router/blob/main/lib/resty/router/context.lua#L115
